children: Ares Capital completed a $750 million offering of 6.250% unsecured notes due September 15, 2033, under a supplemental indenture with U.S. Bank Trust Company. The company also entered into a Purchase Agreement with a syndicate led by BofA Securities and J.P. Morgan Securities to underwrite the offering, which closed on September 15, 2026. In tandem, Ares Capital executed a $750 million interest rate swap with JPMorgan Chase Bank, receiving 6.250% fixed and paying three-month SOFR plus 1.85250% through maturity. Net proceeds will repay borrowings under existing credit facilities, with capacity to reborrow for general corporate purposes.

: Underwritten purchase agreement for 6.250% notes due 2033

: Interest rate swap on $750 million notional
: Convert fixed coupon to floating rate exposure
